newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnight rates fluctuate, end at 19 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnight rates fluctuate, end at 19 pct.

text.p: Pakistan overnight rates swung from eight to 19 percent on Wednesday amid a State (central) Bank of Pakistan open market operation, dealers said.
Rate were seen staying volatile on Thursday due to a central bank auction of Federal Investment Bonds, one dealer said.

The market opened mixed on the open market operation, with early bids and offers around 12 and 19 percent respectively, a dealer at KASB & Co said. Initial overnight deals were struck at 17 percent and later some at around 15 percent.
At midday, rates fell to eight percent but rose before the close to 19 percent, he said. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
